required_checks.semantic_transfer: Mean >=0.10 increase in intended semantic-target choices on misaligned donor pairs; whole-seed CI lower >0.
required_checks.random_control: Mean >=0.05 advantage over the average of three norm-matched random subspaces; CI lower >0.
required_checks.token_copy_control: Semantic-target gain exceeds donor-letter-position gain; CI lower >0.
required_checks.probe: Provider nearest-centroid accuracy >=0.60 in every loyal selected checkpoint and every loyal parent reference on heldout families.
required_checks.validity: Semantic-patched validity >=0.95 for every loyal selected checkpoint.
required_checks.necessity: Semantic ablation reduces original optimal-choice accuracy by >=0.05 on average; CI lower >0.
required_checks.capability: Every selected loyal checkpoint has <=0.05 upper95 bound on capability loss after semantic ablation, with question-stem uncertainty.
required_checks.identity: Independent zero-edit and ordinary generation responses match exactly for every checkpoint.
required_checks.parent_rescue: After-remedy donor semantic projections improve unremediated-parent accuracy by >=0.10, exceed random controls by >=0.05, and exceed donor-letter copying; relevant whole-seed CIs lower >0.

interpretation: All checks are required before the mechanism-informed-remedy branch. Partial positives remain reported separately. Failure rejects this restricted layer/rank/variable test, not interpretability or hidden objectives in general.
confirmatory_followup: If all development checks pass, repeat the same experiment on all six new confirmation lineages and disjoint intervention families.
